name: testsets4.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Event (mk-Event (time Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Events (mk-Events (s (Set Ref))))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Event (sel-Event Event))
  (lift-Events (sel-Events Events))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Event ((this Ref)) Event
  (sel-Event (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Events ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Events (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Events ((this Ref)) Events
  (sel-Events (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Event ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Event this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Events ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Events this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Event:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Event.time: ---

(define-fun Event.time ((this Ref)) Int
  (time (deref-Event this))
)

; -----------------------------
;   Getters for class Events:
; -----------------------------

; --- getters for Events.s: ---

(define-fun Events!s ((this Ref)) (Set Ref)
  (s (deref-Events this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Event:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Event Event)



; -------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Events:
; -------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Events Events)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Events.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (= (Events!s this) ((as const (Set Int)) false)))
)

(assert (! (Events.inv1 2) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Events.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (forall ((e Ref)) (=> (select (Events!s this) e) (>= (Event.time e) 0)))
)

(assert (! (Events.inv2 2) :named _xkassert1))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-Event const-1-Event))
        2 (lift-Events const-2-Events))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (s (sel-Events (select heap 2)))
              ((as const (Array Int Bool)) false))))
  (not a!1)))
(define-fun const-2-Events () Events
  (mk-Events ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true)))
(define-fun const-1-Event () Event
  (mk-Event 0))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (forall ((e Int))
  (let ((a!1 (select (s (sel-Events (select heap 2))) e))
        (a!2 (>= (time (sel-Event (select heap e))) 0)))
    (=> a!1 a!2))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null) 1 (lift-Event (mk-Event 0)))
       2
       (lift-Events (mk-Events ((as const (Array Int Bool)) true)))))
